title: 1RB1RE_1RC0RF_0LD---_1LE1LD_1RA0LB_0RE1LC: a block accelerator, no halt in 2.16·10<sup>12</sup> steps
text: An exact block accelerator (whole-block crossings, repeated moving fronts, cached chunks) is checked against the plain simulator up to 5·10<sup>11</sup> steps. It then follows the run to 2.16·10<sup>12</sup> steps with no halt: a regular phase ends, a hand-over rebuilds the tape, a longer regular phase follows, and a second hand-over begins.
